summary.zh-TW: 聯合報引述北水分署，4 月 2 日清晨至 5 日下午，寶山與寶二水庫集水區累積降雨約 281 mm。
summary.en: UDN reported the Northern Region Water Resources Branch’s account of about 281 mm of rainfall in the Baoshan and Baoshan II catchments from the morning of 2 April to the afternoon of 5 April.

sources.label: 4 月降雨報導 / April rainfall report

title.zh-TW: 新竹與臺中水情恢復正常
title.en: Normal water status restored in Hsinchu and Taichung

summary.zh-TW: 水利署公告自 5 月 26 日起，新竹與臺中水情由提醒綠燈恢復正常；公告指出寶山與寶二水庫已滿庫。
summary.en: WRA announced normal water status in Hsinchu and Taichung from 26 May, replacing the green advisory. The announcement reported full storage at Baoshan and Baoshan II.

sources.label: 水利署原始公告 / WRA announcement
次日新聞報導 / Following-day news report

summary.zh-TW: 氣象署資料記錄巴威於 7 月 11 日接近臺灣；同日 NOWnews 報導寶二與鯉魚潭蓄水率達 100%。此事件發生在長期雷達缺口之後。
summary.en: CWA records Bavi near Taiwan on 11 July. NOWnews reported 100% storage at Baoshan II and Liyutan that day. This event occurred after the long radar-product gap.

sources.label: 氣象署颱風資料庫 / CWA typhoon record
